caption: The drawing depicts a wooden-framed settee with six legs, each leg featuring a turned design and brown coloring. The arms of the settee are curved, connecting to the top of the backrest, and are also brown, matching the frame and legs. The settee is upholstered with a light blue fabric that has a subtle pattern of vertical stripes and small dotted motifs, covering the seat, backrest, and inner arms. The outer background of the drawing is a plain beige color, and there are no additional objects or elements surrounding the settee. The artist's signature, "John Dieterich," appears in the bottom left corner.
title: Sofa
